text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mubarak and Chirac agree on the importance of the U.S. and French roles in the peace process. The two leaders held talks in Cairo on the peace process and ways to boost relations between Egypt and France. Mubarak tells news conference after talks that failure of Palestinian-Israeli talks would be a disaster and that main solution to current situation is for Israel to implement agreements it has signed.
- After Egyptian request, Greece agrees to extradite Hoda Abdel-Moneim, who is wanted in Egypt on embezzlement charges.
- Shimon Peres to visit Cairo on Sunday for talks on developments in the peace process.

- Crisis in relations between France and Britain over Chirac's statements. Mubarak tells news conference after talks that everybody's goal is a peaceful solution and Chirac says there is no going back on peace process.
- Russian foreign minister to visit Cairo on Wednesday.
- Prime Minister Ganzouri to visit China in December.
- Iraqi industrial delegation to visit Cairo in mid-November.
